scope: Official route and GPX status audit for ten records in the historic/original top-level event list 39–48; this is not the current event-dates.json insertion range 39–48.

policy.historicalGpx: Existing GPX files remain valid until a new official file has been released, downloaded and validated. Never delete or replace a historical file merely because a new edition is announced.
policy.binaryValidation: No external GPX binary in this package was downloaded and parsed by the available inspection tools. Direct links and official map export availability are recorded separately from binary validation.
policy.appChanges: Audit-only checkpoint; no app route data or GPX files changed.

events.finding: Official organizer page confirms the three formats and that downloadable GPX stage maps are included. Stage dates/legs: 3 Jun Berchtesgaden–Marktschellenberg; 4 Jun Marktschellenberg–Bischofswiesen; 5 Jun Bischofswiesen–Ramsau; 6 Jun Ramsau–Berchtesgaden. No direct public GPX file URLs extracted.
events.followUp: Obtain official stage downloads/Komoot voucher and associate stage files with the correct multi-day formats.

events.name: Jenaer Backyard Ultra

events.followUp: Keep GPX pending; request official file from organizer if a map/track is needed.

events.name: mozart 100 by UTMB
events.finding: The official 2027 event inventory includes six formats, including Ultra Relay. The previously recorded key mismatches remain: 119 km / 6000 m+ 100 and 12 km / 200 m+ Lake Trail are required; official Marathon is 44/1600 and Half is 28/1100. Interactive Map + GPX sections exist, but direct file URLs were not extracted.
events.followUp: Reconcile the app to six official formats, including Ultra Relay, and extract GPX from each official race map.

routes.gpx: official Racemap GPX download; high-level race route

routes.name: Ultra Scotland 100
routes.gpx: official Racemap GPX download; high-level race route and low-level severe-weather alternative

events.finding: Both official race pages expose GPX downloads via the embedded Racemap map. The 100-mile event is specified as 104 miles / 4,611 m+, not exactly 100 miles, and has two alternatives (high-level race route and low-level severe-weather route).
events.followUp: Download both 50-mile and 100-mile high-level GPX files; keep the 100-mile low-level route separately labelled as a weather alternative and validate the binaries.

events.name: Falkensteinlauf
events.finding: Organizer confirms the 2027 date (17 July) but has not published 2027 route distances, elevation totals or GPX. The page describes the course surface as 85% forest road and 15% asphalt, with a short steep rise (about 17 m over 170 m) per lap; number of laps/total route length is not stated in the current 2027 notice.
events.followUp: Keep route metrics and GPX pending until the 2027 registration/race information is published.

events.name: Trail 100 Andorra by UTMB
events.finding: The official 2027 inventory has five races. The short course is officially named Trail 25K (actual 24.9 km), not Trail 21K; the prior detail URL for the 21K label returned 404. Official pages show interactive map/GPX sections, but direct file URLs were not extracted.
events.followUp: Rename the 24.9 km entry to Trail 25K; verify the official route page and extract GPX exports for all five races.

events.name: Ötscher Trail
events.finding: The organizer confirms five individual competitions and an interactive 2027 route map. Official page confirms Vertical Race 5.1 km / 1140 m+; ITRA-linked event data gives Marathon 51/2300, Speed 16/940 and Skyrace 23/1980. The current official page text does not provide reliable Easy Trail metrics in the extracted material. Five direct GPX links were recorded in the earlier checkpoint but their binary contents/year/distance have not been validated here.
events.followUp: Keep all five prior GPX links as candidates only; validate each file against the 2027 map and obtain the Easy Trail metrics from the organizer.
